title: PlayStation 1 — Crash Bandicoot disc example
creator: Lincoln Aleixo
licenseScope: Original contributions only. Crash Bandicoot artwork, PlayStation and other third-party marks, scan and reference photography are excluded; see CREDITS.md and NOTICE.md.
changes: First separately versioned Crash Bandicoot (1996), SCUS-94900 standalone disc example; neutral playstation-1 0.1.0 remains unchanged.

Applied AI-assisted approximate color restoration to the flat scan, using a photographed physical disc to replace its pink cast with an orange field, blue-violet ink and neutral gray silver areas. Fine lettering may differ from the original scan.

Used sRGB artwork, roughness 0.68 and reduced print specular reflection. Silver print areas use gray albedo rather than a per-pixel metallic mask; the center hole, clear hub and dark reading face are preserved.

godot.surfaceInspection: Embedded artwork, UVs and separate print surfaces verified; label specular compensated in the consumer because the importer ignores KHR_materials_specular.

validation.publicationPreparation: Original GLB geometry, materials and embedded texture bytes preserved exactly; root metadata updated for publication. Editable sources reopened and packed image and interface paths sanitized.
validation.previewLighting: Neutral white lights; Blender Standard view transform, exposure -1.65. Lighting differs from the neutral release previews; no geometry change.
